component: Board settings menu duplicating the resize control
explanation: Owner: the board settings menu repeats Larger, Smaller, Largest that fits and Restore size although a dedicated resize control already exists beside the board. A function should have one obvious home unless duplication has a clear usability reason.

classification.rationale: P09, P10 and P21 push toward fewer controls but none states that a function has one home. A resize command in a settings menu next to a dedicated resize control is the example; any app with a direct manipulation control plus a menu would repeat it. Suggested principle: no duplicated control ownership. Owner decides.
